desc:
Hook rare fish, raid other players, and flex your glowing aquarium. 🌊🐟
Fish and Steal — catch, steal, and upgrade! 💸✨

Dive into Fish and Steal! 🎣 

Catch fish across day & night 🌞🌙, raid other players to steal their catch 🏃‍♂️💨🐟, and bank it to upgrade your own glowing aquarium 🐠🏦. 
Unlock new rods 🔓🎣, craft powerful baits 🧪, and chase time-limited rares ⭐️. 
Grow your aqua capacity 📈, show off your top trophy in style 👑, and flex your island tank to everyone around 🏝. 
Play solo or team up with friends for contracts and social rewards 🤝💰. 
Can you build the brightest tank on the server? 💡

🐟 Hook it, steal it, and make it shine! ✨
